annotations.title: Rank your providers for a job right now, on Dependency Pulse readings (signed)

description: Which provider should your agent use right now for a job? Send the job kind (chat-model, embeddings, email-send, payments, cloud-hosting) and the providers you can use, in your own order; get them back ranked for right now by one published rule on Dependency Pulse readings (steady up first, then recovering, maintenance, degraded, no current reading, outage; your order kept inside each group), with the reading behind each place and a signed record. Never calls a provider or holds keys; the tool stores nothing. Free: 100 calls a day per caller; paid calls past that are staged on test money, not charging.

providers.description: Provider ids you can use for this job, in your own order (best first). Leave out to rank every provider read for the job kind.
